prompt.task: Propose one executable facility-inspection workflow from public development evidence.

grammar.text_fields: diagnosis and expected_effect are strings of at most600 characters

rule_domains.threshold: ONE NUMBER, not an object; choose from allowed_thresholds_by_signal for this signal

semantics.refresh_s: History temperatureCVAE inference period; causal feature frames still every30s.
semantics.cooldown_s: Only extra checks; never prevents the next protected tour obligation.
semantics.risk: Public model or measured severity feature, not hidden fault truth or calibrated probability.
semantics.uncertainty: Absolute history versus nominal model disagreement /20, not calibrated uncertainty.
semantics.age: Public time since task completion divided by task deadline.
semantics.ordered_rules: For the first role-matching rule with qualifying candidates, use its ranker on those candidates.
semantics.rankers: risk or disagreement times public asset weight divided by ETA; urgency is age plus ETA ratio.
semantics.fallback: Frozen trainedPPO scores all remaining candidates if no rule triggers.
semantics.protection: Complete-return gate, two extra checks per owned round, qualification and physical service are immutable.

prompt.selection: Minimize violating tasks; maximize coverage; maximize weight of distinct first measured-alert tasks; minimize public weighted age; minimize travel. Lexicographic strict improvement. Persistent rechecks add no discovery reward.
rules: Return JSON only. Exact grammar; no code, new fields, labels, equipment IDs or metric changes.
Weights, physical processes, measurement validity, interpreter, budgets and hidden evaluator stay fixed.
Changing a workflow is task-level adaptation; the improver itself is fixed in this pilot.

proposal.diagnosis: The current workflow has a refresh interval of 30 seconds and a cooldown of 60 seconds, but no rules are defined. This may lead to suboptimal detection and response to facility issues, especially in high-risk or uncertain conditions.
proposal.expected_effect: The proposed workflow introduces three rules to enhance detection of thermal, electrical, and cooling risks, prioritizing risk and urgency for faster response. This should improve coverage, reduce violations, and ensure more effective facility inspection.
